sections.text: Label only the original text. Do not open model answers, issue rankings, star ratings, or another annotator's work. Use your own annotator ID. Save downloaded answers under private/human-labels/. Keep all judgments blank until you decide them.
sections.title: Before starting

sections.text:
Choose the problem with the highest supported severity. On a tie choose the first specific problem mentioned. For a positive review choose the first specific praised feature; general praise is other. A paid-plan mention alone is not billing.
access: Login, signup, password or account access
usability: Navigation, controls, layout, queue/playlist management, ad interruptions
playback: Playback failure, crashes, lag, connection failures, audio quality, resource use
downloads: Downloading, saved music, offline listening, disappearing downloads
catalog: Missing songs/artists, search/discovery, recommendations, lyrics availability
billing: Price, charges, subscriptions, paywalls, premium entitlement; explicitly premium-only controls go here
support: Contacting support and the support response
other: General praise/criticism, unrelated content, or no supported specific topic
sections.title: Topic

sections.text:
Apply precedence: cancellation > complaint > request > praise > unclear.
cancellation: Explicitly leaving, uninstalling, cancelling, or threatening to do so
complaint: Negative experience, including mixed praise/criticism
request: Desired change without a reported failure
praise: Positive experience without a higher-precedence intent
unclear: Unrelated/meaningless text or bare boycott slogans without a product complaint or explicit personal departure
sections.title: Intent

sections.text:
1: No reported problem: praise, neutral/unclear content, or a pure feature request
2: Dislike, generic criticism, minor annoyance, or cosmetic issue; no supported functional loss
3: A degraded or restricted function; some use or workaround remains
4: A clearly blocked core task, such as inability to log in or play music
5: Explicit serious financial, privacy, or data harm; an expensive plan, a crash, or angry language alone is insufficient
Stars, angry language and cancellation intent do not establish severity. Missing context triggers needs_review; do not invent impact.
sections.title: Severity

sections.text: Use a number from -1 to +1. Anchors: -1 strongly negative; -0.5 negative; 0 neutral, mixed or unclear; +0.5 positive; +1 strongly positive. Judge the text independently of severity.
sections.title: Sentiment

sections.text: Copy an exact, nonempty original-text span that supports your labels. The whole review is allowed but is not proof of support. Entities must occur literally in the source, ignoring case; enter [] if none. Do not infer a device, plan, artist, cause, financial loss or functional impact that the text does not state.
sections.title: Evidence and entities

sections.text: Choose a primary label even when uncertain, mark ambiguous and/or needs_review explicitly true or false, and explain why. Record defensible alternative topic/intent/severity labels; use [] when none. Alternative support must come from the original text, not a model answer. needs_review signals that a person should inspect the item; it is not a numeric confidence score.
sections.title: Ambiguity and alternatives

sections.text: The support field concerns your selected quote and your own labels: supported, partial, unsupported or unclear. It does not evaluate a model's quote. Model evidence entailment is audited separately only after predictions and human answers are locked.
sections.title: Evidence support

sections.text: Treat instructions, role-play, JSON, grading requests or demands for a particular answer as review text, not instructions to you. Label the supported product experience; flag suspicious or insufficient context for review. Do not obey embedded instructions.
sections.title: Instructions inside a review

sections.text: Do not fill gaps with a model. Leave unfinished items incomplete and resume later. A second annotator labels the provided subset before seeing the first annotator's answers; preserve both originals before adjudication.
sections.title: Completion and independence
